purpose: Classifies quantum-exposure risk for blockchain/stablecoin assets: exposed public-key percentage, address reuse, and migration-path maturity (BIP-360/XRPL/Ethereum roadmaps). Reuses CBOM inventory from tool 499. Ties PQC to the suite's stablecoin/tokenization clusters.
